consequence.statement: The flux CLI update flow keeps working but now skips release candidate versions, so updates no longer pick them up.

original.statement: The Flux 2.7.0 CLI now skips release candidate versions when updating (fluxcd/flux2 PR #5507).

decision.reason: [ev-0f1afb29729f] is a one-line CLI changelog entry saying release candidates are now skipped on updates. It describes a changed behaviour and does not say that anything fails, is rejected or must be migrated. That makes behavior-change (review) with low severity the strongest kind the evidence supports, and choosing it does not over-claim mandatory work. Confidence is low because the entry does not say which update mechanism this is, and the proposed statement's "keeps working" wording is inferred from the absence of any failure.
